note: G8 M6. A block may write its words in any order, so `P2000 M98 Q50` is the same subprogram call as `M98 P2000 Q50`: it starts program 2000 at THAT program's N50, which this file cannot renumber. The guard only looked to the right of M98, so the P in front of it was not seen and the Q was rewritten with the caller's own new number. It is reported and kept now, while the plain local call on the next line is still followed.
